hero.title: Innovation Team
hero.subtitle:
At the University of Tiaret,
The Innovation Team unites creative and ambitious students to explore ideas, technology, and entrepreneurship.
hero.subtitle_3: Through hands-on projects, teamwork, and inspiring events.

Get_to.title: Get to know the Innovation Team
Get_to.left_content: Founded at the University of Tiaret, the Innovation Team is a community of passionate students driven by curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. We focus on transforming ideas into impactful projects that inspire and empower the next generation of innovators.
Get_to.right_content: Join the Innovation Team to dive into the world of technology, design, and entrepreneurship! Whether you’re a coder, designer, engineer, or just eager to learn, you’ll find your place here. Take part in our workshops, challenges, and events — and be part of a community that’s shaping the future from Tiaret.
